source.notes: 네온 레인 2087, an SF action game (fictional)
Korean OFL fonts, cut to the characters the reel shows

rationale.palette: Night in violet and navy (#07041A to #2A0E3E, a magenta city glow at the horizon); neon in magenta #FF2E88, cyan #2EE6FF, yellow #FFD23A, green #3AFF9E and orange on Korean signs; everything doubled and smeared in the wet street.
rationale.type: Do Hyeon for the title, the lines and the signs (tall, condensed, sign-painter Korean), Orbit for the UI, the HUD and the numbers; both in RGB-split glitch lettering.
rationale.motion: A trailer in the rain: slow push-ins, parallax towers in three depths, signs that stutter, rain that never stops, reflections that ripple, cars that streak; glitch bursts (slices of the frame thrown sideways) on the cuts and on the hack.
rationale.sound: Dark synth at 112 BPM in E minor (7 bars in 15 s, 14 in 30 s), saw pad, saw-pluck arps, rolling saw bass; digital SFX: glitches on the titles, whooshes for the cars, keystrokes and a lock for the hack.
rationale.visuals: All code: seeded towers with window grids, vertical neon signs, a hologram koi billboard, rain streaks and splashes, a street that mirrors the frame above it in rippling strips, a hooded walker, flying cars, a HUD.
rationale.narration: Not recommended: a trailer of lines on screen.
